label: rare copy-phase feature, mostly on fed-back input 2 (or k)
explanation: Very sparse (0.03% of steps) and fires only in the copy phase, at recall_idx 1-5 and mostly 1-2 steps before the end; it never fires in the original or delimiter phases. 68% of activation mass falls on steps whose fed-back input is 2, and 83% on input 2 or k. But only about 1% of copy-phase steps with input 2 fire, so the token alone does not decide it. Firing is enriched when the output is y (22x lift), when L is short (L=3 has 16x lift), and when the sequence holds more digits. The strongest activations look like 2 -> y inside short sequences, e.g. 2 y f <DEL> [2] y. Narrower conjunctions (input 2, output y, to_go <= 2) reach only about 0.18 precision and 0.18 recall. No simple predicate on the available variables reaches usable precision.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: L=3 (+4.95), phase=2 & out_tok=y (+4.70), phase=2 & in_tok=k (+4.40), prev_tok=r (+3.38), phase=2 & in_tok=2 (+3.32), prev_tok=y (+3.31). Lower it: in_first=1 (-3.30), to_go=6 (-2.90), prev2_tok=n (-2.21), to_go=5 (-1.70).
